summary: Sheephorn Mountain Lookout in Lemhi County began as a 1933 wooden cab; its two-story flat cab dates to 1965, and it was registered on the NHLR in 2020.

facts.design: Two-story Region 6 flat cab; 1965 newspaper describes a cinderblock lower section with a wood upper

access.note: Forest Service encourages visitors to hike the peaks, but says nothing about entering the cab. Firelookout.com says it is on the Recreation Rental program; no current listing was found, so that is unverified.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Salmon-Challis National Forest

events.note: 9x9-foot wooden cab, the first lookout on the site.
Newspaper item says a man who had come back from the Hat Creek fire went to the lookout to be on duty for the summer.
Region 6 flat cab replaced the 1933 cab; forest crews worked from August 1 with a November 1 target. NHLR lists 1965 as the build year.
Post-Register reported the site was to be withdrawn as an administrative site to protect the new lookout building.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, October 2, 2020.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources give 1933 for the first cab on the site and 1965 for the current two-story flat cab; the NHLR lists 1965 as the build year. The story reports both.
Firelookout.com says Salmon National Forest; NHLR and the Forest Service page say Salmon-Challis National Forest. The story uses the current name.

The 1965 newspaper describes a cinderblock lower section with a wood upper; NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe a Region 6 flat cab on a concrete base. Both fit a two-story structure; the story reports the newspaper's description.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 2.7 does not appear in any source read, so it is omitted. Brief elevation 2488.4 m matches NHLR (8,164 ft, 2,488 m); firelookout.com gives 8159 ft. Brief 'Sources give different build years' is resolved as 1933 first cab vs 1965 current cab. Rental status is unverified: firelookout.com says the tower is on the Recreation Rental program, but the Forest Service page does not mention rentals and no current recreation.gov listing appeared in search. Idaho Fire Lookouts' 'Emergency Status' tag is not explained anywhere read. The Keeping Watch page (coordinates 44.8825167, -114.0912) matches the brief but was not read for history. The weebly page's 1952 plane-crash item near Sheephorn is not in the story (not about the tower). A search result for Sheep Mountain Lookout in Bighorn NF is a different tower and was not used.
